editorial.blurb: Kimski is a vibrant Korean-Polish fusion spot where inventive dishes, warm hospitality from owner Won, and a connected bar scene create an unforgettable dining experience.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the potato and cheese pierogi—a standout that keeps regulars coming back—and grab a seat at Maria's tiki-inspired bar next door for craft cocktails; the gated seating is 21+ only, but outdoor seating is available up front.
